name: QuestDB
author: QuestDB
description: QuestDB is a high-performance open-source time-series database with SQL support. It ingests millions of rows per second via InfluxDB line protocol, PostgreSQL wire protocol or REST, and ships a built-in web console for queries and charts. This app bundles a maintenance sidecar that provides configurable multi-stage downsampling (via incremental materialized views and TTLs), optional compressed archiving of expired raw partitions, and automatic compressed backups.

form_fields.label: Postgres wire password
form_fields.hint: At least 8 characters. Used for connections on the PostgreSQL wire port 8812.

form_fields.label: Enable read-only Postgres user
form_fields.hint: Second Postgres wire account that can only run SELECT queries — hand this one to Grafana and other dashboards.

form_fields.label: Retention: managed tables
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated table names the retention pipeline should manage. Leave empty to disable downsampling/archiving.

form_fields.label: Retention stages
form_fields.hint: Semicolon-separated <age>:<resolution> stages, last stage may be <age>:drop. Units: h, d, w, M, y. Example: 30d:1h;2y:1d;10y:drop keeps raw data 30 days, hourly aggregates 2 years, daily aggregates 10 years.

form_fields.label: Archive expired raw partitions
form_fields.hint: Instead of deleting raw data older than the first stage, detach the partitions and keep them as compressed archives in app-data/data/archive.

form_fields.label: Backup interval (hours)
form_fields.hint: Compressed full backups via CHECKPOINT. 0 disables backups.
